01
PVH Corp · Calvin Klein & Tommy Hilfiger

Consumer Survey & Brand Mapping

A 26-week mixed-method study across Bengaluru and Guwahati: 371 intercept respondents, invoice analysis, competitor audits, and marketplace benchmarking for India's premium fashion market.

  • 191 CK + 180 TH respondents across Orion · MOA · Phoenix malls
  • Multi-order buyers spend 2.4× (CK) and 3.1× (TH) more — cross-sell flagged as top lever
  • Segmented CK into Blue / Silver / Black spend tiers; 40–44% of female visits are gift-motivated
  • Benchmarked 10+ competitors: Zara, Armani Exchange, Rare Rabbit, H&M, Lacoste
  • 9 strategic recommendations across product, pricing, retail & loyalty

Calvin Klein · Fashion 360 Creative Agency

Creative Direction & Test Shoot

Art-directed a full Calvin Klein test shoot across 10+ women's and men's categories. Conceptualised lighting setups, managed model briefs, styling direction and final image selects; deck presented at HOD level.

  • 10+ categories: Jeans · Shirt · Top · Dress · T-shirt · Skirt · Jacket · Innerwear · Bags
  • 5 distinct lighting setups: circular halo, soft diffused, high-contrast shadow
  • Managed crew: model briefs, styling direction, shot lists, final selects

03
Tommy Hilfiger · SS27 Buying Direction

SS27 Merchandise Buying Direction

Data-backed buying direction for Tommy Hilfiger SS27 across Shirts, Polos, T-shirts and Jeans, built from sales performance analysis, discount benchmarking and consumer preference data.

  • Buying direction across fit, colour, fabric, tenet and commercial rank
  • Polo (39% avg discount) & T-shirt (38%) flagged as margin-risk categories
  • Trade-up strategy recommended to defend margin on core volume sellers
  • SKU-level colour and fit recommendations for open-to-buy SS27 allocation
